presentation.description: Startdev is a teaching platform for developers, aiming to go beyond simple education.

contextualization.title: Understanding the requirements
contextualization.text: Startdev is a learning platform aimed at developers, with the goal of going beyond simple education. The idea is to create a strong and collaborative community, where users help each other learn together. The platform offers a gamified experience, allowing participants to accumulate points whenever they help each other, which can be exchanged for courses or discounts on new purchases within the platform.

objectives.title: Project objectives
objectives.build: Create a platform for teaching devs
objectives.bring: Bring a form of interaction between students

continuing.title: What now?
continuing.text1: My first step was to review the document with the specifications and expectations for the platform.
continuing.text2: I wrote down points of doubt, curiosities and created an interview script to talk to the client using Google Docs.
continuing.text3: During the interview, I tried to understand what he expected in terms of both business and visual aspects. I asked if he had already defined a color palette and asked for examples of websites with visual references that the client liked.

research.title: Research
research.text1: I started an analysis of the websites of direct and indirect competitors using the
research.text3: to organize and detail the information. I recorded the points of interest and what could be relevant to the project, looking for references that added value. The objective was to identify opportunities for improvement and insights, using these platforms as a source of inspiration to develop

objectives.title: During this research phase, I also looked for:
objectives.companies: International companies in the same industry
objectives.platforms: The platforms that developers like and use the most

style_guide.title: Style Guide and Persona
style_guide.text1: Our marketing team had already developed a proto-persona for the project (unfortunately, I couldn't find the file to add to the case). I used this initial direction to start the design process.
style_guide.text2: The client already had the logo, color palette and fonts they wanted to use in the project
style_guide.text3: . With this information in hand, my first step before starting the wireframes was to define a
style_guide.text5: . This helped to standardize the visual elements and facilitated the creation process and consistency throughout the project.

user_flow.title: User Flow
user_flow.text: Before starting to develop the wireframes, the user flow was created. This step was important to clearly map out all the steps that the user would go through within the platform. The user flow not only helped me to better understand the user's journey, but also to have a better idea of ​​the development time and the number of screens needed, allowing for more assertive planning for the next stage of the project, which is in fact the wireframe.

wireframe.title: Wireframe
wireframe.text1: Once we had defined the user flow and had a clear vision of the user journey, the next step was to work on the wireframes before arriving at a final version of the design.
wireframe.text2: I strategically chose to use wireframes at this stage
wireframe.text3: , as they allow you to visualize the structure and functionality of the platform without focusing so much on the visual details. This helped me to:

objectives.intuitive1: Ensure the layout was intuitive and functional, ensuring all user interactions were aligned with the
objectives.fast: Make quick, iterative adjustments to the navigation flow without committing time to visual details that would only be worked on later.
objectives.align3: with the client before moving on to the final design.

high_fidelity.title: High fidelity
high_fidelity.text1: After validation with the client, I increased the fidelity of the wireframes, incorporating more visual and interactive details.
high_fidelity.text2: Additionally, I suggested implementing the platform in dark mode, taking into account that our main target audience is developers, who generally prefer interfaces with less brightness, making the experience more comfortable and aligned with their preferences.

final_thoughts.title: Final Thoughts
final_thoughts.text: This was a really fun project to work on, especially because I was challenged by the short deadline — around 20 days — to deliver both the web and mobile versions.

thought1.title: Time Management and Creativity:
thought1.item1: I managed other projects in parallel and assisted the intern.
thought1.item2: I improved my time management and used my creativity effectively in UI.

thought2.title: Gamification:
thought2.item1: We implement incentives that reward students for interactions.
thought2.item2: Rewards for completing courses, rating lessons, responding to assignments, and interacting in forums.

thought3.title: Customer Satisfaction:
thought3.item: The platform has not yet been launched, but the client was extremely pleased with the result.

thought4.title: Personal and Professional Fulfillment:
thought4.item: The experience of transforming ideas into products brought great personal and professional fulfillment.

persona.title: Persona
persona.quote: I seek flexible credit that fits my store, with competitive rates for safe growth

presentation.title: Presentation
presentation.text: Eduardo is a dedicated and successful entrepreneur who has owned a convenience store for over eight years. He has a strategic approach to retail, constantly seeking ways to improve his business and provide a positive shopping experience for customers. Eduardo is active in his local community, and his store is known for providing quality products and personalized service.

interests.title: Interests
interests.credit: Business Credit and Finance: He is interested in options that offer payment flexibility and longer terms, allowing for more efficient financial management.
interests.technology: Technology and Innovation: he understands the importance of technology in retail and is always looking for innovative solutions that can improve the efficiency of his store, from point-of-sale systems to modern payment methods.

objectives.title: Objectives
objectives.credit_solutions: Find Personalized Credit Solutions: flexible credit programs, with competitive rates and personalized payment options to meet the specific needs of his store.
objectives.integrated_solutions: Technology-integrated solutions, providing a smooth and efficient payment experience for Eduardo's customers.

persona.insights1: From this data collection, we created the CSD matrix

csd_matrix.title: CSD Matrix (Certainties, Assumptions and Doubts)
csd_matrix.text1: Based on the information collected during these conversations, we created a CSD matrix to
csd_matrix.text2: organize what we already knew, what we believed to be true, and the questions we still needed to investigate.
csd_matrix.text3: This helped align expectations and ensure that our next decisions were based on data and not just assumptions.

data_analysis.title: Data Analysis
data_analysis.text: With the CSD matrix data, internal data insights and user complaints.
data_analysis.main_points: I identified the main points for the project:

points.excess_info2: Many users commented on the excessive amount of data required in registration. One of them even joked that it was
points.excess_info3: "easier to get a green card than to register in the app"
points.long_registration2: The process had more than 30 screens, making the experience time-consuming and tiring for users
points.different_interest2: Most users wanted to first explore the app and understand how it worked, rather than focusing on the credit approval process right away.
points.few_features2: The app didn't offer attractions that would encourage continued use, which reduced access frequency
points.lorem_ipsum2: Some screens still contained fictional texts, which gave an impression of lack of professionalism and made the app seem fake.

wireflow.title: Wireflow
wireflow.text: I performed the entire registration flow as a user, identifying the main errors, accessibility issues and documenting each step of the journey. This detailed survey allowed us to map the areas that caused confusion and where improvements were needed to make the process more intuitive and efficient. In addition to mapping both design errors and texts that were in lorem ipsum.

improvements.two_steps2: We created an initial process with basic data, allowing the user to quickly access the app. The second stage is aimed at those who really want to activate the product and request a credit line
improvements.optimize_fields2: We reduced the registration fields, keeping only the information that was really relevant and useful for the process
improvements.accessible_texts2: We implemented simpler and more direct language, as well as intuitive icons to facilitate user recognition and navigation
improvements.validation_flow2: We corrected errors in the registration flow, such as validating the contact number at the beginning, preventing the user from only discovering the error at the end of the process
improvements.mapping_documentation2: The entire registration flow was mapped and documented to avoid rework in the future and ensure greater efficiency
improvements.new_features2: We added a section for the user to track the used and available limit, as well as a tab to access bills directly in the app (previously only possible via desktop). Basic data settings and an FAQ for quick support were also included

wireframes_idea.title: Wireframes and Idea Validation
wireframes_idea.text: Based on the collected insights and the CSD matrix, I developed new functionalities to improve the user experience and increase continuous app usage. I created high-fidelity and navigable wireframes, allowing stakeholders to view and interact with the solutions before implementation.

challenges_items.item1: I had the opportunity to improve my process organization and communication with the team.
challenges_items.item2: Seeing how my teammates understood what UX was and how it adds value to the company in general.

routines_items.item1: I managed to implement design routines with my squad, which was an important advancement.
routines_items.item2: I presented and showed how well-applied UX directly impacts results, which was very rewarding.

opportunities_items.item1: I missed conducting user interviews and usability testing after the final decisions.
opportunities_items.item2: Having closely monitored the impact of these solutions on users would have been ideal to collect more detailed feedback. Despite this, I believe we focused on the most critical points and solved the company's main pain points.

results_items.item1: The research-based suggestions were delivered in high fidelity and in a navigable format.
results_items.item2: I believe that the implemented solutions will improve the user experience and generate positive results for the business in the long term.
